items.title: The Year I Started Leaving Breadcrumbs Instead of Notes
items.summary: I read back six months of my own work journal and found three different note-taking systems, only one of which I remember deciding to build. This is what the volume of information actually did to my notes, what got better, what I lost, and how I capture things now.
